author: PlayStation
description:
Play EA SPORTS FC™ 27 on PlayStation® Tournaments for your chance to win a trip to the Red Bull Wings Cup World Final in Miami. Compete, qualify, and represent your country on the road to the World Final.

Everyone who participates can earn an FC 27 Red Bull Wings Kit and Red Bull Wings Cup Avatar. Finish Top 8 in the Open Qualifiers and you’ll also take home FC Points.

How it works:
• Win your Open Qualifier bracket to advance to the Closed Qualifier
• Win the Closed Qualifier to reach your National Final
• Win the National Final to represent your country in the world finals in Miami
• Make it to the World Final and compete across Miami

Open Qualifiers: September 28 – October 25

Think you have what it takes? Play. Qualify. Represent.

Sign up on PlayStation Tournaments: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/tournaments/

Eligibility, dates, rules and prize details vary by region. See the official tournament page for full details: https://playst.cc/red-bull-wings-cup-rules.

description:
The 2026 World Series has now passed its halfway mark, with Round 3 taking place in Singapore.

In the previous Round in Tokyo, reigning champion José Serrano dominated the race right up until the final lap, only to drop to 5th place due to a costly penalty. This dramatic turn of events has significantly impacted the Points Ranking, in a race where the all the Spaniards were expected to hold the advantage.

Will current leader Kylian Drumont, fresh off his victory in the chaotic Round 2, build momentum to pull away from the pack? Will the Spanish drivers stage a comeback? Or will Valerio Gallo, who has been biding his time and closing in on the leaders, finally launch a serious charge?

With the World Finals fast approaching, the battle for the Nations Cup is becoming increasingly unpredictable. Witness how the competition unfolds!
